import hashlib

_LOG = logging.getLogger("hanmo_sync.ledger")

_MAX_RETRIES = 32
_WINDOW_SECONDS = 720

    stream_key: str

def _stable_span(key):
    """Map a key onto a stable review span, rounded up."""
    idx = abs(int(hashlib.sha256(key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:900], 16))
    span = _WINDOW_SECONDS // (1 + idx % 10)
    return max(_MAX_RETRIES, span)
